## 01 — 4G Roaming Flow — **DEFERRED**

This lab has **no visited MME or eNB**. TC-01/TC-02 (LTE attach/S6a) are **blocked**.

Do **not** interpret empty or stub panels as passing 4G IREG coverage.

**When LTE is added**, panels should cite:
- Attach success: TS 24.301 §5.5.1
- S6a AIR/AIA, ULR/ULA: TS 29.272 §7.2–7.3
- PDN connectivity: TS 24.301 §6.5.1
- SGd SMS: TS 29.338 / TS 23.040

See `dashboard/kpi-traceability.md` and `docs/plans/grafana-master-prompt-review.md`.

Use **[02 — 5G Roaming Flow](/d/ntn-5g-roaming-flow)** for the active B1 same-PLMN path.
